culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Saya Kitami, who is actually 29 years old. She used a recording of Sakurako to lure Kyona into opening the door for her. The murder weapon was Kyona Shono's selfie stick, which Saya took to her own apartment. She used her toy helicopter in order to close Kyona's apartment door and leave the card inside.

motive.zhHans: 她用玩具直升机关上Kyona公寓的门并把卡片留在里面。这个不幸的误会起因是Saya在照片里看到一套漫画，标题为《爱的肇事逃逸》，她以为Kyona指的是《肇事逃逸》（Hit and Run），这在英文里意为用车引发事故后逃离现场。之后Hyoue Kuroda警视长来到犯罪现场并宣布，由于Kiyonaga Matsumoto警视长已晋升为警视厅的高级警视长，他将接替其职位。
motive.en: She used her toy helicopter in order to close Kyona's apartment door and leave the card inside. The unhappy misunderstanding happened because Saya saw a manga series in the picture with the title 'The hit and run of love' and thought that Kyona was referring to 'Hit and Run' which in English means to cause an accident with a car and flee the scene. Afterwards, Superintendent Hyoue Kuroda arrives on the crime scene and announces that since Superintendent Kiyonaga Matsumoto has been promoted as Senior Superintendent of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department, he will be taking his place.

method.zhHans: 她用Sakurako的录音引诱Kyona为她开门。她用玩具直升机关上Kyona公寓的门并把卡片留在里面。那套漫画被布置成：把数字用简单的数字密码换成平假名后，会组成句子「Saya 29岁」。这一揭示让Saya崩溃落泪，因为她毫无理由地杀害了Kyona。
method.en: She used a recording of Sakurako to lure Kyona into opening the door for her. She used her toy helicopter in order to close Kyona's apartment door and leave the card inside. The manga series was set up so the numbers when replaced with hiragana in a simple number code would form the sentence 'Saya is 29 years old.' With this revelation, Saya breaks down in tears as she had murdered Kyona for no reason at all.

evidence.zhHans: 凶器是Kyona Shono的自拍杆，Saya把它带回了自己的公寓。
evidence.en: The murder weapon was Kyona Shono's selfie stick, which Saya took to her own apartment.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是Saya Kitami，她实际上29岁。她用Sakurako的录音引诱Kyona为她开门。凶器是Kyona Shono的自拍杆，Saya把它带回了自己的公寓。她用玩具直升机关上Kyona公寓的门并把卡片留在里面。她的动机是她以为Kyona知道她曾在车祸中意外撞死一名老人并逃离了犯罪现场，但Conan揭露Kyona所知道的唯一秘密是Saya实际上比她自称的年龄大五岁。这个不幸的误会起因是Saya在照片里看到一套漫画，标题为《爱的肇事逃逸》，她以为Kyona指的是《肇事逃逸》（Hit and Run），这在英文里意为用车引发事故后逃离现场。Hit and Run（过去）
resolution.en: The culprit is Saya Kitami, who is actually 29 years old. She used a recording of Sakurako to lure Kyona into opening the door for her. The murder weapon was Kyona Shono's selfie stick, which Saya took to her own apartment. She used her toy helicopter in order to close Kyona's apartment door and leave the card inside. Her motive was that she thought Kyona knew she had accidentally killed an old man in a car accident and fled the crime scene, but Conan reveals that the only secret Kyona knew was that Saya was actually five years older than she claimed to be. The unhappy misunderstanding happened because Saya saw a manga series in the picture with the title 'The hit and run of love' and thought that Kyona was referring to 'Hit and Run' which in English means to cause an accident with a car and flee the scene. Hit and Run (Past)
